title.narrative: Supporting Public Health Care System Strengthening to Achieve Universal Health Care for Mizoram Program

description.narrative: The state government of Mizoram (SGM) is implementing various health insurance programs for different categories of the population. These programs vary in funding sources, implementation mechanisms, and operational processes. In 2023, the SGM approved the Mizoram Universal Health Care Scheme (MUHCS) by integrating existing health insurance programs under one umbrella to expand financial health protection to the uncovered population, especially women, older people, and persons with disabilities (PWDs). To ensure that public health facilities are ready to provide services under MUHCS with trained human resources, there is a need to strengthen capacity of Mizoram's public health care system. The results-based lending (RBL) program will support the state of Mizoram to strengthen its public health care system to provide affordable and quality services at the primary care level and to link such services with health care at the secondary and tertiary levels through MUHCS to ensure a continuum of care. MUHCS will provide harmonized health insurance under which all citizens of Mizoram are covered, and the cost for poor and vulnerable people is completely borne by the SGM. The RBL program will strengthen Mizoram's public health care and MUHCS systems to offer affordable and quality health services for all in a sustainable way.
